_doc: Substances found in the source prescriptions that the diet assistant must be structurally unable to propose. Criterion (data owner): prescription drugs and any anabolic / hormonal product, or a commercial name that suggests one, are excluded from the food catalogue; vitamins, minerals, amino acids, proteins and herbal/botanical supplements are kept. Keys are normalised (build_food_catalog.normalize_key). `status`: excluded = confirmed; pending_review = excluded until the data owner decides otherwise. Brands with a legitimate generic function are NOT excluded: they map to the generic through brand_map.json (viggro -> amilopectina).
